items.question: How wide are your turf rolls?
items.answer: All of our turf is sold in standard 15-foot wide rolls. When you bring in your measurements, we can help you plan your cuts to minimize waste and save money.

items.question: Can I get a sample before I buy?
items.answer: Absolutely. Visit our Queen Creek showroom and take home free samples from any product in our collection. See and feel the quality before you commit.

items.question: Face weight vs pile height?
items.answer: Face weight (oz) is how dense the turf is — more ounces = more durable. Pile height is how tall the blades stand. For high-traffic areas and pets, we recommend 90+ oz face weight.

items.question: Do you offer wholesale pricing?
items.answer: Yes. We offer exclusive wholesale pricing for licensed contractors. Call or text us directly for contractor rates — pricing listed on this page is standard retail.

items.question: Is your turf safe for pets?
items.answer: Yes. All products are pet-friendly and guaranteed lead-free. We also carry Oxy Turf Cleaner, specifically formulated for pet odor and sanitation on artificial grass.

items.question: What warranty do your products carry?
items.answer: All turf products come with a 15-year manufacturer warranty. We stand behind every product we carry.
